title: Gifto's Lahore Karahi, Pakistani Entrepreneurship and Educational Success
episode_summary: James Staples and Luke Heslop visit Gifto's Lahore Karahi in Southall with co-owner Faisal Ali to explore the relationship between Pakistani migration, entrepreneurship, and food culture. Faisal recounts his father's journey from Pakistan to Britain in 1960, his transition from working at British Airways to establishing grocery stores and eventually one of Southall's best-known restaurants. The episode examines how food became central to Pakistani social life, how restaurants evolved with second-generation entrepreneurs, and how education became a pathway for social mobility. Professor Peggy Froerer provides anthropological insights into educational aspirations among British Pakistani communities and the distinctive success of Southall's diaspora.
